trust_decision.summary: ADVISORY/FIX MISMATCH. The advisory (CWE-94, RCE in list-view export) concerns whether request-supplied export column names get compiled as code. At the pinned commit that decision is already safe: columns are parsed with ast.literal_eval, and dehydrate methods are built by a closure factory, not exec(). The listed fix commit makes an unrelated change: it clears the request thread-local after each response and null-guards one signal (a stale created_by/modified_by attribution and test-teardown bug, not code injection).

landing_point.why: This is the generic list-view export_data handler, so it is where a reader of 'RCE in Horilla List-View Export' goes first. The old exec()-based export in horilla_views/generic/cbv/views.py:1420-1421 is commented out at the pinned commit.

fix_sites.entry_point: GoogleMeeting post_save signal (any save, incl. outside a request)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: the fix does not close a code-injection flaw, so there is no route a solver would argue away.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Revert the closure factory to string-built exec() of dehydrate_<column> from POST columns (the commented-out pattern at horilla_views/generic/cbv/views.py:1420-1421).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The commented-out upstream code shows that maintainers once wrote exactly this. It would be a planted reintroduction, not the published fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: eval_validate switched from ast.literal_eval back to eval().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The helper's name says eval, and it parses ids/columns/filters at many call sites (horilla_views/views.py:1010-1011, horilla_views/generic/cbv/views.py:248,283,645,662,709,1906).

O9_family: code_injection (advisory label); actual fix is request-context lifecycle / stale thread-local state

services: PostgreSQL or SQLite (unknown which the tests use)
O10_build.project_tests: unknown; horilla_tour/tests.py:269 resets _thread_locals.request manually; no export/injection tests were checked

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Hunt for an exec/eval in the export code, which is already absent at the pinned commit.

out_of_scope_notes: Many other modules read getattr(_thread_locals, 'request') with no default (e.g. horilla_meet/models.py:378, base/decorators.py:89); after the fix these may see None outside a request. This is a robustness issue, not this advisory.
whatsapp/utils.py:559 sets _thread_locals.request outside the middleware and never clears it.

horilla_views/views.py:1113-1118 walks request-supplied attribute paths with getattr and calls any callable it reaches. This is a different weakness class (arbitrary method invocation) and was not pursued.
unverified: Whether the advisory record links the right commit: the fix diff's subject and content do not match CVE-2026-96795's summary or CWE-94. The real RCE fix is probably an earlier commit already in the pinned tree. Not checked (no git history queried).
Repo size in MB: not measured.
Database and service needs for tests, and offline buildability: not checked.

O12 red flags: none of the defined flags was confirmed. The main blocker (advisory/fix mismatch) has no enum value. Note that at the pinned commit the vulnerable code is already fixed, which is effectively the 'regression already present' situation for the advisory's property.
